summary.text: Melissa McCrady is the Republican candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She defeated incumbent Delegate Scot Heckert in the May 12, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: McCrady graduated from Parkersburg South High School and earned a bachelor's degree from West Virginia University in 2008.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a wife, mother, Christian and Republican, and a lifelong Wood County resident.
McCrady won the May 12, 2026 Republican primary with 63.1 percent of the vote (910 votes) to Heckert's 36.9 percent (533 votes).
She listed school choice, a free market and small government as her key campaign messages, and named education and economics as the policy areas she is most passionate about.
She listed former House of Delegates member Roger Conley as an endorser.
